theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_ah_product_integral_reduce
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (h f ψ₀ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo c d → H p = h p.1) → (∀ t, t ∉ Ioo a b → f t = 0) → (∀ α, α ∉ Ioo c d → ψ₀ α = 0) → ∫ α, ψ₀ α = 1 → ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, f p.1 * ψ₀ p.2 * H p = ∫ t, f t * h t
